about.description: Happy Pappys is a local, family-owned coffee shop founded by the Papadelias family. The business was inspired by a coffee shop the family discovered in Texas and opened in August 2019. They provide a premium third place where patrons can unwind, socialize, and recharge while enjoying high-quality coffee and delicious food. The shop survived Hurricane Sally and the COVID-19 pandemic in its first year of operation.
about.elevator_pitch: A welcoming, family-owned local coffeehouse dedicated to spreading love and happiness through premium coffee and community connection.
about.vibe: Warm, inviting community gathering space that feels like home; a third place beyond work and residence where people can belong
about.insider_tip: Ask about their hard bean coffee raised at 1200 meters, which customers rave is better than Blue Mountain or Kona. Join Pappy Hour on Thursdays for live music and drink specials.
